outcomes: Acknowledged boundaries and combat-start precede simulation
Safe phase clocks and gameplay mutations freeze during checkpoint writes
A real joining WebSocket client waits and enters the next checkpoint
A frozen purchase cannot spend coins
Combat continues during lease refresh; failed recovery stays unavailable
Terminal runs finalize; disposal cannot start combat after a delayed response
Checkpoint status is sent only to ready clients
limitations: Local SQLite and actual loopback WebSockets; no deployed D1 recovery
Synthetic timing, victories and outages; no human or device evidence
Server-only factory disabled in normal/public execution
Participant credentials, stable transport bindings and individually durable command acknowledgements remain unfinished
New UI messages are authored in 15 locales, without browser/native-speaker review
